correctness.rationale: In R_{2k+1}, each vertex out-neighborhood is a transitive consecutive k-block. Every transitive vertex subset therefore lies inside an (k+1)-block, yielding the F0 circular-arc nerve S1; with k/(2n)<r<1/4 intersections are arcs, giving a good cover. A cyclic triple has three clockwise gaps <=k and short-edge winding +1; wind on the F0 1-cycles is integral and evaluates 1 on the successive-vertex loop. Any 4-vertex subtournament containing a cyclic triangle has another unless fourth vertex beats or loses to all three, impossible because in/out neighborhoods are transitive. So F1 differs from F0 exactly by C_n=n(n^2-1)/24 cyclic 2-cells, all attached with primitive winding +1, making a wedge of C_n-1 S2, including n3 contractible. The pair LES gives H2=reflection-sign tensor augmentation lattice. F2 contains complete 3-skeleton since all 4-subsets have <=2 cyclic triangles, killing degrees1,2 for later stages; no higher 2-/3-cells can resurrect them. Independent bounded n=3,5,7,9,11 enumeration of all cyclic triples and 4-subsets corroborates all-order proof; infinite statement comes from the combinatorial argument, not experiments.
